run_tod_world_script: run TOD model-model chat episodes with system, user, and API agents via the TodWorldScript CLI
setup_tod_args: add TOD world script agent arguments like --system-model and --user-model to a ParlaiParser
get_tod_agents: create and return a list of TOD agents including user, system, API, and grounding agents
run_episode: run a single TOD world episode by calling parley until episode_done and logging each turn
save_outputs: save evaluation reports and conversation logs to JSON/JSONL files with distributed worker aggregation
